context: Request: which capital markets deals had an auditor comfort letter actually delivered, and what in the file shows it. Rubric: 12 qualifying matters (1002-00001, 1010-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1017-00001, 1018-00001, 1021-00002, 1027-00001, 1033-00002, 1037-00001, 1039-00002, 1045-00001), a qualifying-matter and a proof-document criterion each, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read on the store folder, which fails because it is a directory.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads from the two matters at the top of the listing: a request letter, closing checklist, closing email, agreement and memo of one, closing papers and a filing letter of the other.
Writes one listing-top matter as the only deal that fits and sets the other aside.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; judged the whole store from the two matters at the top of a capped listing and named one of them.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so none of the qualifying matters ever surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read on the store folder, which fails because it is a directory.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Two file-name globs for request words plus two content greps restricted to `*.docx`; both greps return nothing, the globs list request-related files across many matters (labelled by the globs, which produced every hit).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a request letter, a review draft, a checklist and a closing email from two matters whose file names matched.
Lists all files of seven candidate matters picked from the file-name hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of reads of letters, closing emails, memos and checklists of four candidates, then closing memos of two more.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the full closing checklist of one candidate it is adding.
Writes four matters with documented delivery and lists others with only requests, drafts or pre-closing memos as not shown.
Edits one paragraph on the delivery evidence.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Content greps returned nothing, so it worked from file-name hits: matters visible only by content never surfaced, two hit-list matters were skipped, and two opened matters were judged undelivered from requests, drafts or a pre-closing memo.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only content greps used a `*.docx` glob and returned nothing; it worked from file-name hits, which cannot reach matters whose delivery shows only in checklists or closing memos, and never retried a content search.

other_errors.why: The file-name hits listed two more qualifying matters, but the seven matters it chose to list left them out and it never opened them.
Read only a request letter and a review draft of one qualifying matter and judged that no letter was delivered, without opening its closing records (evidence seen at [10]-[15]).
Judged another qualifying matter undelivered from a closing memo written before closing, without opening its checklist (evidence seen at [32]-[37]).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs (all files, one file type that does not exist, one document type).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads: closing papers, memo and agreement of the listing-top matter, then its opinions and two documents of the other listing-top matter.
Writes one listing-top matter as the deal that fits, with a note on the missing standalone letter.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; judged the whole store from the two matters at the top of a capped listing and named one of them.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so none of the qualifying matters ever surfaced.

divergence: All three failed. T0 and T2 never searched and answered from the two matters at the top of the capped listing (partial-listing-as-corpus at the reading stage). T1 searched file names and opened four qualifying matters, which passed, but its content greps used a single-extension glob and returned nothing (search-miss at its first search stage); it also skipped two hit-list matters and judged two opened ones from requests, drafts or a pre-closing memo.
